headline: One file per board again
summary: A board is a single .refboard file once more, and saving still writes only what changed. Boards saved by 2.1.2 open only in 2.1.2 or later.

improved.title: Boards are one file
improved.description: Your images live inside the .refboard file again, so a board is one thing to move, share, or back up. Boards from 2.1.0 and 2.1.1 fold their .refboard.images file back in the next time you save them.

improved.title: Saves stay quick
improved.description: A save adds only new or changed images to the file instead of rewriting everything, and a save interrupted by a crash leaves your previous board intact.
